script_text: Stop! Aries, the cosmos is lighting up your communication sector right now and it demands your attention. Mars, your ruling planet, is moving through your 3rd House of Communication, forming a challenging square to Mercury. This Fire element energy creates intense mental sparks that could ignite conflicts in everyday interactions. If single, a mysterious stranger will cross your path through a mutual friend—don't dismiss them. If taken, hidden tensions surface; address them before midnight. Your 10th House of Career activates with Jupiter's presence, opening unexpected professional doors this week—speak up in meetings, opportunities favor the bold. Avoid impulsive spending today—your 2nd House of Finances is under pressure from Saturn's influence. Follow for tomorrow's reading where the Moon reveals your hidden strengths.
